<!-- Generated by tools/docgen from doc comments. Do not edit: run scripts/docs.sh. -->

```odin
import synth "fire:synth"
```

A wavetable synthesizer's parts: wavetables, the oscillator that plays
them with unison and warps, and (in time) its filters, modulators, voice
and node.

A `Wavetable` is up to `WAVE_FRAMES` single-cycle frames of `WAVE_SIZE`
samples, kept as spectra. An oscillator reads a frame through a wave
buffer it rebuilds every few milliseconds (`wave_build`): the frame's
harmonics up to the highest that stays below Nyquist at the note's pitch,
turned back into a wave. So nothing aliases however high it plays, and a
spectral change (a morph) is only a change to those harmonics.

```odin
frames := [][]f32{saw[:], square[:]}
t, _ := synth.wavetable_make("Saw to square", frames)
defer synth.wavetable_destroy(t)
```


```odin

```

Frames (at the voice rate) between modulation steps: envelopes, LFOs

```odin

```

```odin

```

```odin
LINE_POINTS :: 32
```

The most points a line-shape keyframe has.

### TABLE_HARMONICS

```odin
TABLE_HARMONICS :: 64
```

Harmonics a harmonics keyframe sets.

### WAVE_SIZE

```odin
WAVE_SIZE :: 2048
```

Samples in a wavetable frame (one cycle).

### WAVE_BINS

```odin
WAVE_BINS :: WAVE_SIZE / 2
```

Bins of a frame's spectrum (`WAVE_SIZE` / 2: the first holds DC and
Nyquist together, as `dsp.Real_Fft` packs them).

### WAVE_FRAMES

```odin
WAVE_FRAMES :: 256
```

Frames a wavetable can have. A table made from fewer keyframes is
interpolated out to this many, so a frame position moves smoothly.

### WAVE_PAD

```odin
WAVE_PAD :: 3
```

Samples of padding around a wave buffer: one before and two after, so
a cubic read never has to wrap.

## Types

### Builtin_Table

```odin
Builtin_Table :: enum u8 {
	Basic_Shapes,
	Saw,
	Sine,
	Square_Pwm,
	Harmonic_Sweep,
	Vowels,
	Sync_Saw,
	Drawbars,
}
```

The wavetables the synth has built in. Each is generated here, from
shapes and additive recipes; none is copied from anywhere.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Basic_Shapes` | sine, triangle, saw, square, then a narrow pulse |
| `Saw` |  |
| `Sine` |  |
| `Square_Pwm` | a square narrowing to a thin pulse |
| `Harmonic_Sweep` | a sine gaining harmonics one octave at a time, up to a full saw |
| `Vowels` | a buzz through the formants of a, e, i, o, u |
| `Sync_Saw` | a saw hard-synced from 1× to 8× its rate |
| `Drawbars` | organ registrations, flute to full |

### Env_Params

```odin
Env_Params :: struct {
	delay: f32,
	attack: f32,
	hold: f32,
	decay: f32,
	release: f32,
	sustain: f32,
	attack_power: f32,
	decay_power: f32,
	release_power: f32,
}
```

An envelope's settings: times in seconds, sustain 0..1, and each
curved segment's power (0 straight). A negative decay or release power
drops fast, then slows (as a natural decay does); a positive attack
power rises fast, then slows.

### Lfo_Mode

```odin
Lfo_Mode :: enum u8 {
	Trigger,
	Sync,
	Envelope,
	Sustain_Envelope,
	Loop_Point,
	Loop_Hold,
}
```

How an LFO runs against its note.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Trigger` | restarts with each note, loops |
| `Sync` | loops in step with the song (the transport's position), whatever the note |
| `Envelope` | runs once from each note, then holds |
| `Sustain_Envelope` | runs to its phase point while the note is held, then on to the end |
| `Loop_Point` | once through, then loops from its phase point |
| `Loop_Hold` | loops up to its phase point while held, then on to the end |

### Lfo_Rate

```odin
Lfo_Rate :: enum u8 {
	Seconds,
	Tempo,
	Dotted,
	Triplet,
	Keytrack,
}
```

What sets an LFO's rate.

```odin
Lfo_Params :: struct {
	mode: Lfo_Mode,
	rate: Lfo_Rate,
	hz: f32,
```

An LFO's settings.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `mode` |  |
| `rate` |  |
| `hz` | Seconds: cycles a second |
| `tempo` | Tempo, Dotted, Triplet: an index into LFO_TEMPO_RATIOS |
| `key_transpose` |  |
| `key_tune` | Keytrack: semitones off the note |
| `phase` | 0..1: where it starts (or its loop or hold point) |
| `fade` | seconds to fade in, from the shape's start value |
| `delay` | seconds before it starts |
| `smooth` | glide toward the shape (a half-life of `smooth_time` / 5) |
| `smooth_time` | seconds |
| `stereo` | -0.5..0.5: the right side's phase offset from the left |

### Random_Style

```odin
Random_Style :: enum u8 {
	Perlin,
	Sample_Hold,
	Sine_Interpolate,
	Lorenz,
}
```

How a random modulator wanders.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Perlin` | smooth noise: a slope at each step, eased between |
| `Sample_Hold` | a new value each step, held |
| `Sine_Interpolate` | a new value each step, glided to along half a cosine |
| `Lorenz` | the Lorenz attractor's x: never repeats, never jumps |

### Unison_Stack

```odin
Unison_Stack :: enum u8 {
	Normal,
	Center_Drop_Octave,
	Center_Drop_Octave_2,
	Octave,
	Octave_2,
	Power_Chord,
	Power_Chord_2,
	Major_Chord,
	Minor_Chord,
	Harmonic_Series,
	Odd_Harmonic_Series,
}
```

How unison voices are tuned against each other: all around the note
(Normal), or some an interval away.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Normal` |  |
| `Center_Drop_Octave` | the centre an octave down |
| `Center_Drop_Octave_2` | the centre two octaves down |
| `Octave` | pairs alternate the note and an octave up |
| `Octave_2` | the note, an octave and two up |
| `Power_Chord` | the note, a fifth and an octave |
| `Power_Chord_2` | ... up to two octaves |
| `Major_Chord` |  |
| `Minor_Chord` |  |
| `Harmonic_Series` | pair n on harmonic n |
| `Odd_Harmonic_Series` | pair n on odd harmonic 2n-1 |

### Osc_Warp

```odin
Osc_Warp :: enum u8 {
	None,
	Sync,
	Formant,
	Quantize,
	Bend,
	Squeeze,
	Pulse_Width,
	Fm_A,
	Fm_B,
	Fm_Sample,
	Rm_A,
	Rm_B,
	Rm_Sample,
}
```

How an oscillator bends its phase (or its output) before reading the
wave: the warp. FM and RM take another oscillator's output (A and B:
the first and second other oscillators) or the sample oscillator's.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `None` |  |
| `Sync` | hard sync: the wave played 1/16 to 16 times a cycle |
| `Formant` | sync, windowed by a half sine: a formant that moves |
| `Quantize` | the phase stepped |
| `Bend` | the phase bent by a cubic: the wave leans |
| `Squeeze` | the first half squeezed, the second stretched |
| `Pulse_Width` | the cycle played faster, then silent: a pulse of it |
| `Fm_A` |  |
| `Fm_B` |  |
| `Fm_Sample` | phase modulated |
| `Rm_A` |  |
| `Rm_B` |  |
| `Rm_Sample` | ring modulated |

### Osc_Params

```odin
Osc_Params :: struct {
	table: ^Wavetable,
	frame: f32,
	level: f32,
	pan: f32,
	unison: int,
	detune_cents: f32,
	detune_power: f32,
	blend: f32,
	stereo_spread: f32,
	stack: Unison_Stack,
	phase: f32,
	random_phase: f32,
	warp: Osc_Warp,
	warp_amount: f32,
	warp_spread: f32,
	warp_phase: f32,
	morph: Spectral_Morph,
	morph_amount: f32,
}
```

What an oscillator plays for one render, with modulation applied and
in its working units (see each).

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `table` |  |
| `frame` | 0..1 across the table |
| `level` | the output's amplitude, already squared from the level control |
| `pan` | -1 (left) .. 1 (right) |
| `unison` | 1 ..= OSC_MAX_UNISON |
| `detune_cents` | the outermost voices' detune (range × detune) |
| `detune_power` | -5..5: how the voices between are spread (0 evenly) |
| `blend` | 0..1: the centre's level against the detuned voices' |
| `stereo_spread` | 0 (mono) .. 1 (pairs fully left and right) |
| `stack` |  |
| `phase` | 0..1: a read offset |
| `random_phase` | 0..1: how much each voice starts at a random phase |
| `warp` |  |
| `warp_amount` | 0..1 |
| `warp_spread` | -0.5..0.5: the warp's amount across the unison voices |
| `warp_phase` | 0..1 (0.5: none): where in the cycle the warp centres |
| `morph` |  |
| `morph_amount` | 0..1 (see `Spectral_Morph`) |

```odin
Global_Field :: enum u16 {
	Volume,
	Polyphony,
	Mono,
```

The global parameters.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Volume` | dB |
| `Polyphony` | voices 1..32 |
| `Mono` | 0 poly, 1 mono (retriggers), 2 legato (glides, no retrigger) |

| `Glide_Slope` | -8..8: the glide's curve |
| `Glide_Octave` | 0/1: a glide takes longer the further it goes |
| `Glide_Always` | 0/1: glide on every note, not only overlapping ones |
| `Bend_Range` | semitones |
| `Velocity_Track` | 0..1: how much velocity sets the level |
| `Transpose` | semitones, whole |
| `Tune` | -1..1 semitone |
| `Oversampling` | 0 1×, 1 2×, 2 4×, 3 8× |
| `Priority` | a `Voice_Priority` |
| `Macro_1` |  |
| `Macro_2` |  |
| `Macro_3` |  |
| `Macro_4` | 0..1 |
| `Pitch_Wheel` | -1..1 (set by MIDI) |
| `Mod_Wheel` | 0..1 (set by MIDI) |
| `Aftertouch` | 0..1 (set by MIDI) |

### Route

```odin
Route :: struct {
	source: Mod_Source,
	dest: core.Param_Id,
	amount: f32,
	power: f32,
	bipolar: bool,
	stereo: bool,
	bypass: bool,
}
```

A route: `source` moves `dest` by `amount` (a share of its range, -1..1)
through a curve (`power`, as envelope curves). Bipolar sources swing
both ways about the middle; stereo routes move the right side the
other way; bypassed routes do nothing.

### Spectral_Morph

```odin
Spectral_Morph :: enum u8 {
	None,
	Vocode,
	Formant_Scale,
	Harmonic_Stretch,
	Inharmonic_Stretch,
	Smear,
	Random_Amplitudes,
	Low_Pass,
	High_Pass,
	Phase_Disperse,
	Shepard_Tone,
	Skew,
}
```

How an oscillator morphs its frame's spectrum.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `None` |  |
| `Vocode` | the frame's spectral envelope over every harmonic: a buzz through its formants |
| `Formant_Scale` | the spectrum's shape drawn in (down) or out (up), the harmonics where they are |
| `Harmonic_Stretch` | harmonic k moved to k^p: a bell or a squash, still harmonic |
| `Inharmonic_Stretch` | partials spread as a stiff string's are (wider apart going up), or squeezed |
| `Smear` | each harmonic's level carried up into the ones above it |
| `Random_Amplitudes` | each harmonic's level scattered (the same scatter each time) |
| `Low_Pass` | harmonics above a cutoff gone (the cutoff falls as the amount rises) |
| `High_Pass` | harmonics below a cutoff gone |
| `Phase_Disperse` | each harmonic's phase turned by the square of its number: a chirp |
| `Shepard_Tone` | crossfaded to itself an octave up (1: the octave) |
| `Skew` | each harmonic read from a frame further along the table (or back), the higher the further |

### Wavetable

```odin
Wavetable :: struct {
	name: string,
	frames: int,
	spectra: [][1024]complex64,
	waves: [][2048]f32,
}
```

A wavetable: `frames` frames (1, or `WAVE_FRAMES`), each a spectrum
scaled so that an inverse `dsp.Real_Fft` gives the wave back as it was.
`waves` keeps the frames as samples, for drawing. Made with
`wavetable_make`; read-only once made, so the audio thread may read it
while the control thread holds it.

## Procedures

### builtin_table

```odin
builtin_table :: proc(which: Builtin_Table, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (^Wavetable, core.Error)
```

Control thread. Makes built-in table `which` (free with
`wavetable_destroy`).

### effect_node_create

```odin
effect_node_create :: proc(e: fx.Effect, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (node: core.Node, n: ^Effect_Node)
```

Control thread. A node playing effect `e` at its defaults. Added with
four inputs and two outputs, inputs 3 and 4 are the compressor's
sidechain key.

### effect_node_params

```odin
effect_node_params :: proc(e: fx.Effect) -> []core.Param_Info
```

The parameters an effect's node has.

### effect_of_param

```odin
effect_of_param :: proc "contextless"(id: core.Param_Id) -> (e: fx.Effect, ok: bool)
```

Which effect a synth parameter id belongs to (false: none).

### effect_param

```odin
effect_param :: proc "contextless"(e: fx.Effect, f: T) -> core.Param_Id
```

The id of effect `e`'s parameter `f` (a field of its own enum).

### is_effect_param

```odin
is_effect_param :: proc "contextless"(id: core.Param_Id) -> bool
```

Whether `id` is an effect's.

### effect_chain_params

```odin
effect_chain_params :: proc "contextless"(values: []f32, order: [9]fx.Effect, bpm: f64) -> fx.Chain_Params
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The chain's settings from plain parameter values (by id, as a
patch holds them), the effects in `order`, synced to `bpm`: what a
synth with those values runs (less its modulation).

### env_gate_on

```odin
env_gate_on :: proc "contextless"(e: ^Env_State, p: ^Env_Params)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). A note starts it: from where it is (so a retrigger doesn't click),
through the delay if it has one.

### env_gate_off

```odin
env_gate_off :: proc "contextless"(e: ^Env_State)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The note ends: it releases from where it is.

### env_kill

```odin
env_kill :: proc "contextless"(e: ^Env_State)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The voice is stolen: a quick fall to nothing.

### env_step

```odin
env_step :: proc "contextless"(e: ^Env_State, p: ^Env_Params, dt: f32) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Moves it on by `dt` seconds and returns its value then.

### env_render

```odin
env_render :: proc "contextless"(e: ^Env_State, p: ^Env_Params, out: []f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Renders it a sample at a time into `out` (for an amp envelope),
its corners rounded over half a millisecond (where a stage turns into
the next, a straight attack's top: a sharp corner there is a click's
worth of highs, which a compressor lifting quiet bands made a pop).

### env_rounded

```odin
env_rounded :: proc "contextless"(e: ^Env_State, value: f32, dt: f32) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Envelope `e`'s `value`, `dt` seconds after the last, rounded as
`env_render` rounds an amp envelope's (a modulation envelope's too, a
control step at a time: no corner to tick a filter or a pitch).

### env_done

```odin
env_done :: proc "contextless"(e: ^Env_State) -> bool
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Whether it has finished (released to nothing).

### lfo_preset

```odin
lfo_preset :: proc "contextless"(which: Lfo_Preset) -> (s: Lfo_Shape)
```

The shape of preset `which`.

### lfo_shape_render

```odin
lfo_shape_render :: proc "contextless"(s: ^Lfo_Shape, table: []f32)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Renders `s` into `table` (`LFO_RESOLUTION` values, one cycle).

### lfo_table_at

```odin
lfo_table_at :: proc "contextless"(table: []f32, phase: f32) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The value of a rendered shape at `phase` (0..1), interpolated.

### lfo_hz

```odin
lfo_hz :: proc "contextless"(p: ^Lfo_Params, bpm: f64, note: f32) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The rate an LFO runs at, in cycles a second.

### lfo_note_on

```odin
lfo_note_on :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Lfo_State, p: ^Lfo_Params, hz: f32, song_seconds: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). A note starts it. In Sync mode it starts where the song is
(`song_seconds` into it at `hz`).

### lfo_sync

```odin
lfo_sync :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Lfo_State, hz: f32, song_seconds: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). A Sync LFO put where the song is (`song_seconds` into it at `hz`),
each block: it follows the song's position (a stop and play, a loop).

### lfo_note_off

```odin
lfo_note_off :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Lfo_State)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The note is let go (the sustain and hold modes move on).

### lfo_step

```odin
lfo_step :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Lfo_State, p: ^Lfo_Params, table: []f32, hz: f32, dt: f32) -> [2]f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Moves it on by `dt` seconds at `hz` and returns its values (left,
right; 0..1) from the rendered shape `table`.

### random_start

```odin
random_start :: proc "contextless"(r: ^Random_State, p: ^Random_Params, seed: u32)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). A note starts it: from `seed` (the same each note when it
retriggers).

### random_step

```odin
random_step :: proc "contextless"(r: ^Random_State, p: ^Random_Params, hz: f32, dt: f32) -> [2]f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Moves it on by `dt` seconds at `hz` steps a second and returns its
values (left, right; 0..1).

### osc_shared_init

```odin
osc_shared_init :: proc(sh: ^Osc_Shared, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> bool
```

Control thread. Sets up what oscillators share.

### osc_shared_destroy

```odin
osc_shared_destroy :: proc(sh: ^Osc_Shared, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator)
```

Control thread. Frees what `osc_shared_init` made.

### osc_start

```odin
osc_start :: proc "contextless"(s: ^Osc_State, p: ^Osc_Params, seed: u32)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). A note starts: the unison phases set (each at `p.phase`, moved
by up to `p.random_phase` of a cycle at random), the glides reset.
`seed` makes the random phases differ between voices.

### osc_render

```odin
osc_render :: proc "contextless"(sh: ^Osc_Shared, s: ^Osc_State, p: ^Osc_Params, inc: []f32, mod: ^[2][]f32, out_l: []f32, out_r: []f32, raw: ^[2][]f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Renders `len(out_l)` samples of oscillator `s` playing `p`,
writing (not adding) its stereo output (`raw`: before level and pan,
for other oscillators' FM and RM; may be nil). `inc` is the note's
pitch per sample in cycles (one value a sample: glide and pitch
modulation are in it). `mod` is the FM or RM source, a channel each
(nil without). Settings that changed since the last render glide to
their new values across this one.

### power_scale

```odin
power_scale :: proc "contextless"(t: f32, power: f32) -> f32
```

The exponential curve `power` puts on t (0..1); near 0 power, t itself.

### global_param

```odin
global_param :: proc "contextless"(f: Global_Field) -> core.Param_Id
```

The id of global parameter `f`.

### osc_param

```odin
osc_param :: proc "contextless"(n: int, f: Osc_Field) -> core.Param_Id
```

The id of oscillator `n`'s (1..3) parameter `f`.

### sample_param

```odin
sample_param :: proc "contextless"(f: Sample_Field) -> core.Param_Id
```

The id of the sample oscillator's parameter `f`.

### filter_param

```odin
filter_param :: proc "contextless"(n: int, f: Filter_Field) -> core.Param_Id
```

The id of filter `n`'s (1..2) parameter `f`.

### env_param

```odin
env_param :: proc "contextless"(n: int, f: Env_Field) -> core.Param_Id
```

The id of envelope `n`'s (1..6) parameter `f`.

### lfo_param

```odin
lfo_param :: proc "contextless"(n: int, f: Lfo_Field) -> core.Param_Id
```

The id of LFO `n`'s (1..8) parameter `f`.

### random_param

```odin
random_param :: proc "contextless"(n: int, f: Random_Field) -> core.Param_Id
```

The id of random modulator `n`'s (1..4) parameter `f`.

### param_spec

```odin
param_spec :: proc "contextless"(id: core.Param_Id) -> ^Param_Spec
```

The parameter with id `id`, or nil.

### param_curve

```odin
param_curve :: proc "contextless"(spec: ^Param_Spec, plain: f32) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). A plain value (modulation in it) put through its curve.

### mod_source_poly

```odin
mod_source_poly :: proc "contextless"(s: Mod_Source) -> bool
```

Whether a source belongs to a voice (envelopes, voice LFOs, the note)
rather than to the whole synth.

### patch_prepare

```odin
patch_prepare :: proc(p: ^Patch)
```

Control thread. Renders a patch's LFO shapes (call after changing them,
before handing it over).

### patch_default

```odin
patch_default :: proc() -> (p: Patch)
```

Control thread. A patch with triangle LFOs, the effects in their first
order, and no routes, tables or sample (give it tables to make sound).

### patch_add_route

```odin
patch_add_route :: proc(p: ^Patch, r: Route) -> bool
```

Adds a route to `p` (false if it has as many as it can).

### sample_make

```odin
sample_make :: proc(name: string, channels: [][]f32, rate: f64, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (s: ^Sample, err: core.Error)
```

Control thread. A sample from `channels` (one or two, equal length)
at `rate`. Free with `sample_destroy`.

### sample_destroy

```odin
sample_destroy :: proc(s: ^Sample, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator)
```

Control thread. Frees a sample from `sample_make`.

### builtin_noise

```odin
builtin_noise :: proc(which: Builtin_Noise, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (^Sample, core.Error)
```

Control thread. Built-in noise `which`: a second at 44.1 kHz, peak 0.9.

### sample_osc_start

```odin
sample_osc_start :: proc "contextless"(o: ^Sample_Osc, p: ^Sample_Params, seed: u32)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). A note starts it (at its start, or at random).

### sample_osc_render

```odin
sample_osc_render :: proc "contextless"(o: ^Sample_Osc, p: ^Sample_Params, note: f32, out_l: []f32, out_r: []f32, raw: ^[2][]f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Renders the sample oscillator: `note` is the note's pitch as a
key (fractional, glide in it) at the render's end; it writes (not adds)
its stereo output, and `raw` (before level and pan; may be nil).

### spectral_build

```odin
spectral_build :: proc "contextless"(t: ^Wavetable, frame: int, h: int, morph: Spectral_Morph, amount: f32, out: []complex64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Writes into `out` (`WAVE_BINS`) the spectrum of frame `frame` of
`t`, harmonics 1 ..= `h` morphed by `morph` at `amount` (and DC kept,
the rest zero).

### synth_create

```odin
synth_create :: proc(allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator, timeline: core.Timeline_Id = core.Timeline_Id{}) -> (node: core.Node, s: ^Synth)
```

Control thread. Makes a synth node (stereo out) with every parameter at
its default and no patch (silent until `synth_set_patch`).
Its Sync LFOs follow `timeline` while it plays (zero: the transport's
leader; neither playing: the clock's grid).

### synth_set_patch

```odin
synth_set_patch :: proc(s: ^Synth, p: ^Patch) -> bool
```

Control thread. Hands the node `p` (copied): its routes, LFO shapes,
tables and sample take over at the next block. The tables and sample
must stay alive until the node has let the patch go (see
`synth_collect`).

### synth_collect

```odin
synth_collect :: proc(s: ^Synth) -> int
```

Control thread. Frees the patches the node has let go; returns how
many (their tables and sample may be freed once all are).

### synth_scope

```odin
synth_scope :: proc "contextless"(s: ^Synth, out: []f32)
```

The output's last `len(out)` frames (at most SCOPE_FRAMES), oldest
first: a copy for drawing (read while it plays, so a frame or two may
be from the block being written).

### synth_live

```odin
synth_live :: proc "contextless"(s: ^Synth) -> Synth_Live
```

The newest voice, as `Synth_Live` (a copy).

### table_key_default

```odin
table_key_default :: proc(source: Key_Source, position: int = 0) -> (k: Table_Key)
```

A keyframe made `source` way, with every way's data set to something
to start from: a sine (drawn, as lines, as its first harmonic).

### table_doc_default

```odin
table_doc_default :: proc() -> (d: Table_Doc)
```

A table to start editing: a sine at the first frame, a saw (its 64
harmonics) at the last, spectrally blended.

### table_key_render

```odin
table_key_render :: proc(k: ^Table_Key, audio: []f32, out: []f32)
```

Keyframe `k` as a cycle into `out` (`WAVE_SIZE`); `audio` is the
table's sound (mono), for an audio keyframe.

### table_doc_build

```odin
table_doc_build :: proc(name: string, d: ^Table_Doc, audio: []f32, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (t: ^Wavetable, err: core.Error)
```

Control thread. The wavetable `d` makes, called `name`: one frame for
one keyframe, else `WAVE_FRAMES` with each keyframe at its frame (the
first held back to frame 0, the last on to the end) and those between
blended. `audio` (mono) is what audio keyframes slice. Free with
`wavetable_destroy`.

### wavetable_make

```odin
wavetable_make :: proc(name: string, keyframes: [][]f32, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (t: ^Wavetable, err: core.Error)
```

Control thread. A wavetable from `keyframes` (each `WAVE_SIZE` samples;
longer ones are cut, shorter ones padded with zeros). One keyframe
makes a table of one frame; more are spread evenly across
`WAVE_FRAMES`, those between them crossfaded. Free with
`wavetable_destroy`.

### wavetable_destroy

```odin
wavetable_destroy :: proc(t: ^Wavetable, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator)
```

Control thread. Frees a wavetable from `wavetable_make`.

### wave_frame_at

```odin
wave_frame_at :: proc "contextless"(t: ^Wavetable, pos: f32) -> int
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The frame a position `pos` (0..1 across the table) plays.

### wave_harmonics

```odin
wave_harmonics :: proc "contextless"(phase_inc: f64, sample_rate: f64) -> int
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The most harmonics a wave can keep at `phase_inc` (cycles per
sample) without any reaching Nyquist. Above 44.1 kHz it keeps no more
than it would at the nearest lower rate of 44.1 kHz × a power of two,
so a higher rate doesn't add harmonics nobody hears.

### wave_build

```odin
wave_build :: proc "contextless"(fft: ^dsp.Real_Fft, t: ^Wavetable, frame: int, harmonics: int, spectrum: []complex64, out: []f32, morph: Spectral_Morph = Spectral_Morph.None, amount: f32 = 0)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Builds a wave buffer from frame `frame` of `t` keeping harmonics
1 ..= `harmonics` (and DC), morphed by `morph` at `amount` (see
`Spectral_Morph`): `out` is `WAVE_SIZE + WAVE_PAD` samples, the wave at
out[1 ..= WAVE_SIZE] with its ends wrapped around it. `spectrum` is
`WAVE_BINS` of scratch. With no table, the buffer is silent.

### wave_read

```odin
wave_read :: proc "contextless"(buf: []f32, phase: f32) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The wave buffer `buf` (as `wave_build` makes it) read at `phase`
(0..1), with a Catmull-Rom cubic between samples.

## Variables

### BUILTIN_NAMES

```odin
BUILTIN_NAMES: [Builtin_Table]string
```

The names `builtin_table` gives its tables.

### EFFECT_NAMES

```odin
EFFECT_NAMES: [fx.Effect]string
```

The names effects go by, in parameter names and on screen.

### PARAMS

```odin
PARAMS: [dynamic]Param_Spec
```

Every parameter, in id order (filled when the program starts).

### PARAM_INDEX

```odin
PARAM_INDEX: [988]i16
```

Each id's place in `PARAMS` (-1: no parameter has it).

### BUILTIN_NOISE_NAMES

```odin
BUILTIN_NOISE_NAMES: [Builtin_Noise]string
```

The names `builtin_noise` gives its samples.
